title: Evaluator review
description: Written by the evaluator subagent to .agents/tasks/<id>/review-<round>.json. One file per round; never overwritten.

base.description: Commit the diff was taken from (merge base with main).

head.description: Commit (or 'WORKTREE' for uncommitted changes) that was reviewed. An approve needs a SHA: the Autonomy gate accepts later commits only when they touch .agents/ alone.

test_run.description: The local run used as evidence (logs/test-summary.json). An approve needs status pass, commit == head and dirty false.

ci_e2e.description: Conclusion of the CI 'End-to-end tests' check run on head (scripts/gh-rest.sh checks). An approve needs it not to be failure; 'absent' is normal before the PR exists, and the required check blocks the merge until it is green.

verdict.description: approve only when no blocker or major finding remains and every acceptance criterion is met.

id.description: AC id from the spec, or a brief-local id like B1.

evidence.description: Test class#method or file:line proving it, or why it is missing.

test.description: Test class#method that fails without the change. null forces status not_met unless the criterion is not testable by code (then say why in evidence).

file.description: Production file that implements the criterion.

defect_type.description: What went wrong, independent of the area in 'category'. Defined in .agents/README.md; drives the growth rule (scripts/review-defects.sh).
